name: The Hall of Champions
firstVisit: A roar comes down the ladder: a crowd, very close now, chanting a name.

R: Carved deep: THE KALDORIUM. STRENGTH ABOVE ALL.
Under it, a list of champions. Every name has been chiselled off but one.
KALDOR. Then, in fresher stone: KALDOR. KALDOR. KALDOR. Five hundred years of KALDOR.
9: A letter, pinned to the wall with a dagger. The seal is the king's.
WARDEN. Make sure you put on a show tonight.
The last few weeks have been very one-sided. A bored crowd starts thinking, and I don't pay you to make them think.
Maybe take a vacation. Give the prisoners a chance. A small one.
P.S. Do NOT eat the challenger again.
2: A ladder up. The crowd is right above you.
1: Back to the Test of the Mind.
3: Back to the Test of Strength.
k: A candle, burning steady. Somebody left it here on purpose.
Whatever's up that ladder, you'll want your hearts full first.
